reproduced_defects: KnowledgePlane read all allowlisted files before checking trust domain, crashing on unauthorized missing files
Exact spans were missing; results only contained trimmed joined strings with loose line bounds
Unknown queries with zero matches returned status PASS instead of explicit NO_MATCH

observations: Pre-authorization enforces trust_domain filtering before opening any files
Canonical path enforces realpath resolution to prevent symlink escape
lineSpans preserves raw line content without stripping whitespace
Locators are exact: single line, contiguous range (#Lstart-Lend), or discrete line lists (#L5,L20), never a false contiguous range over non-matching lines
Individual spans contain line_number, exact text, locator, and span_hash
